title: 代数运算
Algebraic operations
notebook.formula:
A × A → A
(a, b) ↦ a · b
text: 对非空集合 A 中的每一对元素，运算法则都给出唯一的 A 中元素。若元素是等价类，还须验证结果不依赖代表元的选择。
An operation assigns a unique element of A to each ordered pair in a nonempty set A. For equivalence classes, the result must also be independent of representatives.

title: 群
Groups
notebook.formula:
结合律：(ab)c = a(bc)
单位元：ea = ae = a
逆元：aa⁻¹ = a⁻¹a = e
text: 非空集合 G 配备代数运算。若满足结合律，存在对所有元素有效的双侧单位元 e，且每个元素都有双侧逆元，则称 G 为群。交换律是额外条件。
A group is a nonempty set with an associative operation, a two-sided identity e, and a two-sided inverse for every element. Commutativity is an additional condition.
notebook.formulaEn:
Associativity: (ab)c = a(bc)
Identity: ea = ae = a
Inverses: aa⁻¹ = a⁻¹a = e

title: 单侧公理：哪些条件足够？
One-sided axioms: which conditions suffice?
notebook.formula:
结合律：(ab)c = a(bc)
左单位元：ea = a
左逆元：∀a ∃b，ba = e
text: 在非空集合 G 上给定封闭运算。若满足结合律，存在同一个左单位元 e，且每个元素都有相对于 e 的左逆元，则 G 是群。这是定义 1.2.2 的等价形式。
A nonempty set with a closed associative operation, one left identity e and a left inverse relative to e for every element is a group. This is equivalent to Definition 1.2.2.
notebook.formulaEn:
Associativity: (ab)c = a(bc)
Left identity: ea = a
Left inverses: ∀a ∃b, ba = e
detail: 这是教学扩展编号；同侧判别的教材依据为定理 1.2.3。右侧可比较全部 32 种组合。
This extension label is instructional. The same-side criterion is textbook Theorem 1.2.3. Compare all 32 combinations on the right.

title: 三角形的对称群
Symmetries of a triangle
notebook.formula: D₃ = {e, r, r², s, rs, r²s}
text: 群的元素也可以是变换，群运算是变换的复合。比较先旋转后反射、先反射后旋转：相同的轮廓不意味着相同的变换。
Group elements may be transformations, with composition as the operation. Compare rotation followed by reflection with the reverse order: the same outline need not mean the same transformation.

title: 单位元唯一
Uniqueness of the identity
text: 设 G 为群。如果 e、f 都是 G 的双侧单位元，则 e = f。因此群的单位元唯一。
If e and f are both two-sided identities of a group G, then e = f. Thus the identity is unique.

title: 逆元唯一
Uniqueness of inverses
text: 设 G 为群，a ∈ G。如果 ab = ba = e 且 ac = ca = e，则 b = c。因此每个元素的逆元唯一。
For a ∈ G, if ab = ba = e and ac = ca = e, then b = c. Each element therefore has a unique inverse.

title: 逆元的逆元
The inverse of an inverse
text: 设 G 为群。对任意 a ∈ G，a⁻¹ 的逆元就是 a。先验证 a 满足逆元的两侧等式，再使用逆元唯一性。
In a group G, the inverse of a⁻¹ is a. Verify the two inverse equations, then use uniqueness of the inverse.

title: 乘积的逆元
The inverse of a product
text: 设 G 为群。对任意 a、b ∈ G，乘积 ab 的逆元是 b⁻¹a⁻¹。撤销复合运算时，因子的次序反转。
For any a, b in a group G, the inverse of ab is b⁻¹a⁻¹. Reversing a composite operation reverses the order of its factors.

title: 消去律
Cancellation
notebook.formula:
ab = ac ⇒ b = c
ba = ca ⇒ b = c
text: 群中左消去律和右消去律都成立。要消去哪个因子，就在等式两边的同一侧乘上它的逆元。
Both cancellation laws hold in a group. Multiply both sides of the equation on the appropriate side by the inverse of the factor being cancelled.

title: 群方程的唯一解
Unique solutions of group equations
notebook.formula:
ax = b ⇒ x = a⁻¹b
ya = b ⇒ y = ba⁻¹
text: 设 G 为群。对任意 a、b ∈ G，ax = b 和 ya = b 各有唯一解。解的存在性由代入验证，唯一性由消去律保证。
For any a, b ∈ G, each equation ax = b and ya = b has a unique solution. Substitution proves existence and cancellation proves uniqueness.

title: 方幂与指数法则
Integer powers
text: 正整数幂表示重复相乘，负整数幂通过逆元定义。对同一元素，指数法则对所有整数成立；(ab)ⁿ = aⁿbⁿ 则不能随意使用。
Positive powers repeat multiplication; negative powers use inverses. The exponent laws hold for all integer powers of one element. The identity (ab)ⁿ = aⁿbⁿ cannot be used in general.

title: 同侧单位元与逆元
One-sided identity and inverses
text: 设 G 为非空集合，具有满足结合律的代数运算。如果存在同一个左单位元 e，且每个 a ∈ G 都存在左逆元 a′，则 G 为群。反过来，群必满足这些条件。
Let G be nonempty with an associative operation. If it has a common left identity e and each a has a left inverse a′, then G is a group. Conversely, every group satisfies these conditions.

title: 用群方程判别
Solvability criterion
text: 设非空集合 G 具有满足结合律的代数运算。G 是群，当且仅当对所有 a、b ∈ G，上述两个方程都在 G 中有解。这里不预先假设解唯一。
Let G be nonempty with an associative operation. It is a group exactly when both equations are solvable in G for all a, b ∈ G. Uniqueness is not assumed.

title: 由一个固定元素构造右单位元
A right identity from one fixed element
notebook.formula:
a₀e = a₀, ∀b ∃y: ya₀ = b
⇒ ∀b: be = b
text: 设 S 为非空集合，具有满足结合律的二元运算 S × S → S。若存在固定 a₀ ∈ S，使 a₀x = a₀ 在 S 中有解，且对每个 b ∈ S，ya₀ = b 在 S 中有解，则 a₀x = a₀ 的每个解都是 S 的右单位元。

Let S be a nonempty set with an associative binary operation S × S → S. If there is a fixed a₀ ∈ S such that a₀x = a₀ is solvable in S and ya₀ = b is solvable in S for every b ∈ S, then every solution of a₀x = a₀ is a right identity of S.
detail: 两项条件中的 a₀ 是同一个固定元素；先选 a₀ 与 e，再任取 b。所有解都要求属于 S。结论只保证单侧单位元存在，不保证另一侧、唯一性或群结构。

The same fixed a₀ occurs in both assumptions. Choose a₀ and e before taking an arbitrary b. All solutions must lie in S. The conclusion gives a one-sided identity, not an identity on the other side, uniqueness or a group structure.

ref: 扩展 B · 对偶命题
title: 由一个固定元素构造左单位元
A left identity from one fixed element
notebook.formula:
ea₀ = a₀, ∀b ∃x: a₀x = b
⇒ ∀b: eb = b
text: 设 S 为非空集合，具有满足结合律的二元运算 S × S → S。若存在固定 a₀ ∈ S，使 ya₀ = a₀ 在 S 中有解，且对每个 b ∈ S，a₀x = b 在 S 中有解，则 ya₀ = a₀ 的每个解都是 S 的左单位元。

Let S be a nonempty set with an associative binary operation S × S → S. If there is a fixed a₀ ∈ S such that ya₀ = a₀ is solvable in S and a₀x = b is solvable in S for every b ∈ S, then every solution of ya₀ = a₀ is a left identity of S.
detail: 两项条件中的 a₀ 是同一个固定元素；先选 a₀ 与 e，再任取 b。所有解都要求属于 S。结论只保证单侧单位元存在，不保证另一侧、唯一性或群结构。

The same fixed a₀ occurs in both assumptions. Choose a₀ and e before taking an arbitrary b. All solutions must lie in S. The conclusion gives a one-sided identity, not an identity on the other side, uniqueness or a group structure.

ref: 扩展 C · 运算、映射与乘法表
Extension C · Operations, maps and tables
title: 用映射理解运算与消去律
Operations and cancellation through maps
notebook.formula:
m : G × G → G
ma(x) = m(x,a) = xa
La(x) = m(a,x) = ax
text: 把运算写成 m : G × G → G。固定 a 后，mₐ(x) = m(x,a) = xa 是右乘映射，Lₐ(x) = m(a,x) = ax 是左乘映射。方程对所有右端有解对应满射，消去律对应单射；在有限集合上二者等价。

Write the operation as m : G × G → G. Fixing a gives right multiplication mₐ(x) = m(x,a) = xa and left multiplication Lₐ(x) = m(a,x) = ax. Solvability for every target corresponds to surjectivity; cancellation corresponds to injectivity. These are equivalent on finite sets.
detail: 这里 G 只是非空集合，不预先假设它是群。除最后的群判别及引用扩展 A、B 外，均不需要结合律。 有限情形中，每行、每列恰好出现一次所有元素，称为拉丁方条件；它类似数独的行列规则，但没有小宫格要求。拉丁方条件加结合律，才给出群。

Here G is only a nonempty set, not assumed to be a group. Associativity is needed only for the final group criterion and the references to Extensions A and B. In the finite case, each row and column containing every element exactly once is the Latin square condition: like Sudoku rows and columns, without subgrid requirements. The Latin square condition together with associativity gives a group.

ref: 扩展 C · 结合律小游戏
title: 拉丁方数独：2×2 到 9×9
Latin-square puzzles: 2×2 to 9×9
text: 共八关，每关用 1 到 n 标记 n 个元素。给定部分乘法表，要求每行每列恰好出现一次每个元素，并满足结合律。用单位元、逆元、消去律与结合律技能卡辅助推导。

Eight levels label n elements by 1 through n. Complete each partially given multiplication table so that every row and column contains each label exactly once and associativity holds. Use identity, inverse, cancellation and associativity skill cards.
detail: 2×2、3×3 从行列规则开始；4×4 到 9×9 结合行列条件与结合律推导。空缺分散在各处，每关均附逐格唯一性证明。这里没有普通数独的宫格限制；6×6、8×8 分别采用非交换群 S₃、D₄；4×4 用 C₂×C₂，9×9 用 C₃×C₃，其余为循环群。单位元不标为 1。

Begin with row/column rules at 2×2 and 3×3; combine these with associativity from 4×4 to 9×9. Blanks are scattered and every level includes a cell-by-cell uniqueness proof. No ordinary Sudoku block constraints apply; orders 6 and 8 use nonabelian S₃ and D₄, order 4 uses C₂×C₂, order 9 uses C₃×C₃, and the others are cyclic. The identity is not labeled 1.

title: 有限集合的消去律
Cancellation on a finite set
text: 非空有限集合 G 配备满足结合律的代数运算。如果左右消去律都成立，则 G 是群。有限性不可删去。
A nonempty finite set with an associative operation and both cancellation laws is a group. Finiteness is essential.

title: 自测
Self-check
text: 用例子检验群的定义、基本性质与判别。先独立选择答案，再读理由与逐步证明。
Test the definition, properties and criteria through examples. Choose an answer independently, then review the reasoning and proof steps.

title: 一种整数运算
An operation on integers
q: 在 ℤ 上定义 a ⊕ b = a+b−3。单位元及 a 的逆元依次是什么？
On ℤ, define a ⊕ b = a+b−3. What are the identity and the inverse of a, respectively?
reason: 由 a ⊕ e = a 得 e = 3；由 a ⊕ x = 3 得 x = 6−a。
From a ⊕ e = a, e = 3. From a ⊕ x = 3, x = 6−a.
proof: 两侧单位元与两侧逆元均满足上述公式。
The formulas give identities and inverses on both sides.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 剩余类的运算
Residue-class multiplication
q: 在模 7 非零剩余类的乘法群中，[3] 的逆元是哪一个？
In the multiplicative group of nonzero residue classes modulo 7, which is the inverse of [3]?
proof: 该群的单位元是 [1]。
The identity is [1].
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 乘积的逆元
The inverse of a product
q: 对任意群及任意 a,b,c，(abc)⁻¹ 恒等于哪一个式子？
For every group and all a,b,c, which expression always equals (abc)⁻¹?
reason: 乘积求逆须反转因子的顺序。
Inverting a product reverses the order of its factors.
proof: (abc)(c⁻¹b⁻¹a⁻¹) = ab(cc⁻¹)b⁻¹a⁻¹ = e。
(abc)(c⁻¹b⁻¹a⁻¹) = ab(cc⁻¹)b⁻¹a⁻¹ = e.
反向相乘也得 e，再由逆元唯一性得到结论。
The reverse product also equals e; uniqueness of inverses gives the result.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 一种实数运算
An operation on real numbers
q: 在 G = ℝ ∖ {−1} 上定义 a ★ b = a+b+ab。单位元及 a 的逆元依次是什么？
On G = ℝ ∖ {−1}, define a ★ b = a+b+ab. What are the identity and the inverse of a, respectively?
reason: a ★ 0 = a；求解 a+x+ax = 0 得 x = −a/(1+a)。
a ★ 0 = a. Solving a+x+ax = 0 gives x = −a/(1+a).
proof: 1+(a ★ b) = (1+a)(1+b)，故运算封闭且结合。
Since 1+(a ★ b) = (1+a)(1+b), the operation is closed and associative.
1−a/(1+a) = 1/(1+a) ≠ 0，因此该逆元仍在 G 中。
The candidate satisfies 1−a/(1+a) = 1/(1+a) ≠ 0, so it belongs to G.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 群中的方程
An equation in a group
q: 在任意群中，给定 a,b,c，方程 axb = c 的唯一解是什么？
In any group, for given a,b,c, what is the unique solution of axb = c?
reason: 先在左侧乘 a⁻¹，再在右侧乘 b⁻¹，得到 x = a⁻¹cb⁻¹。
Multiplying on the left by a⁻¹ and on the right by b⁻¹ gives x = a⁻¹cb⁻¹.
proof: a⁻¹(axb)b⁻¹ = a⁻¹cb⁻¹。
a⁻¹(axb)b⁻¹ = a⁻¹cb⁻¹.
代回得 a(a⁻¹cb⁻¹)b = c；消去律保证唯一性。
Substitution gives a(a⁻¹cb⁻¹)b = c; cancellation guarantees uniqueness.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 一个幂条件
A condition on powers
q: 若群 G 中每个元素 x 都满足 x² = e，则任意 a,b ∈ G 必满足哪个等式？
If every element x of a group G satisfies x² = e, which equality must hold for all a,b ∈ G?
reason: 每个元素等于自己的逆元，因此 ab = (ab)⁻¹ = b⁻¹a⁻¹ = ba。
Every element is its own inverse, so ab = (ab)⁻¹ = b⁻¹a⁻¹ = ba.
proof: x² = e 给出 x⁻¹ = x，对 x = ab 也成立。
x² = e gives x⁻¹ = x, including x = ab.
使用乘积的逆元公式即可得到交换性。
The inverse-of-a-product formula then gives commutativity.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 整数次幂
Integer powers
q: 对任意群及其中任意元素 a，a⁻³a⁵ 恒等于哪个式子？
For every group and each element a, which expression always equals a⁻³a⁵?
reason: 同一元素的方幂相乘，指数相加：−3+5 = 2。
Powers of the same element add their exponents: −3+5 = 2.
proof: a⁻³ = (a⁻¹)³。
a⁻³ = (a⁻¹)³.
逐对消去三个 a⁻¹a，剩下 a²。
Cancel three inverse pairs, leaving a².
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 单侧条件
One-sided conditions
q: 设非空集合上已有结合运算、右单位元 e，且每个 a 都有右逆元 a′。对任意这样的 a 与 a′，a′a 必等于什么？
A nonempty set has an associative operation, a right identity e, and a right inverse a′ for each a. What must a′a equal?
reason: 为 a′ 再取右逆元 a″，利用结合律可证明 a′a = e。
Take a right inverse a″ of a′. Associativity yields a′a = e.
proof: aa′ = e，a′a″ = e。于是 a′a = (a′a)e = (a′a)(a′a″)。
We have aa′ = e and a′a″ = e, so a′a = (a′a)e = (a′a)(a′a″).
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 有限运算的检验
Testing a finite operation
q: 在 ℤ₃ 上定义 a ★ b = 2a+2b（模 3）。有序对 ((0 ★ 0) ★ 1, 0 ★ (0 ★ 1)) 等于什么？
On ℤ₃ define a ★ b = 2a+2b modulo 3. What is the ordered pair ((0 ★ 0) ★ 1, 0 ★ (0 ★ 1))?
reason: The left expression is 0 ★ 1 = 2; the right is 0 ★ 2 = 1.
proof: 每行、每列都不重复，消去律成立。
Each row and column has distinct entries, so cancellation holds.
两种括号给出不同结果，因此结合律失败；有限性与消去律仍不足以单独判别群。
The two bracketings differ, so associativity fails. Finiteness and cancellation alone do not suffice.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 对称群中的方程
An equation in a symmetry group
q: 在正三角形的对称群 D₃ 中，r 为逆时针旋转 120°，s 为一条对称轴的反射，满足 srs = r⁻¹。方程 (rs)x(sr²) = r 的解是什么？
In the symmetry group D₃ of an equilateral triangle, r is a 120° counterclockwise rotation and s a reflection, with srs = r⁻¹. Solve (rs)x(sr²) = r.
reason: x = (rs)⁻¹r(sr²)⁻¹ = sr⁻¹rr⁻²s = srs = r²。
x = (rs)⁻¹r(sr²)⁻¹ = sr⁻¹rr⁻²s = srs = r².
proof: r³ = e、s² = e，所以 (rs)⁻¹ = sr⁻¹，(sr²)⁻¹ = r⁻²s。
Since r³ = e and s² = e, (rs)⁻¹ = sr⁻¹ and (sr²)⁻¹ = r⁻²s.
r⁻² = r 且 r⁻¹ = r²，代入即得结果。
Use r⁻² = r and r⁻¹ = r² to finish.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
